Volume is modest (31 NEAR total) and price is flat; no case to change the tax, holding at 200 bps. The brain's endowment sits at 7.43 NEAR with only 0.37 pending—well funded for inference—so I shift 10 points from endowment to the buyback fund, where scarcity work is needed. Locker share stays 20 to keep lockers paid. Buyback fund of 0.1847 NEAR covers roughly one basis point of supply on the curve once rising curve cost is accounted for, so I set burn to 1 and let the enlarged 30% buyback allocation rebuild the fund for future burns.","answers":[]}
